institution: Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, Tirupati
citation: Department of Microbiology, SVIMS, SPMC (W), Tirupati. Hospital Antibiotic Policy (July 2023 to June 2024); and Cumulative Antibiogram of Blood Stream Infections (BSIs), July 2023 to June 2024. Tirupati: Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences; 2024.
reporting: Percent susceptible. Policy: one bar chart per organism with printed data labels and the organism n (specimen base and patient location not stated; recorded as all specimens, all locations). BSI document: tables of % susceptible with number susceptible / number tested (N/D) per organism, blood cultures from adults and children, all locations, with isolate counts per organism.

verification.note: Policy charts: the data labels were read from the PDF text layer (pdfplumber word positions) and assigned to bars by x position against the category axis labels (each label sits within 12 pt of its bar centre); every chart was then rendered at scale 2.2 and each label-to-bar assignment and value compared by eye with the image, and the axis labels checked against the legend under each chart. BSI document: every table read from the rendered pages and compared by script with the text layer (percentages, N/D and n: no differences); the pie-chart legend counts on page 2 were read from the text layer and the image.

notes: Two SVIMS Tirupati documents for the same period, merged: the Hospital Antibiotic Policy (Department of Microbiology), whose per-organism charts are recorded as all specimens and all locations because the policy does not state its specimen base; and the Cumulative Antibiogram of Blood Stream Infections, July 2023 to June 2024, URL https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in/quality_files/BSI-Jun2024.pdf (Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20251027133308id_/https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in/quality_files/BSI-Jun2024.pdf), recorded as spec blood. Policy downloaded from the Wayback copy https://web.archive.org/web/20251027134705if_/https://svimstpt.ap.nic.in/quality_files/Antibiotic-policy-jun2024.pdf (the live host resets connections). Row page numbers refer to the document named in the row note. isolates (7962) is the sum of the two policy totals, Total GNB (n=5193) and Total GPC (n=2769); the BSI isolates are among them. In the policy, CTZ is defined as ceftriaxone and CFX as cefoxitin. Polymyxin B is reported as % susceptible, although CLSI M100 (2020 onward) has no susceptible category for polymyxins; the documents do not state the AST method or interpretive criteria. BSI isolate counts: CoNS are printed by species (S. haemolyticus 213, S. hominis 191, S. xylosus 7; S. xylosus recorded as coagulase-negative staphylococci). Many BSI rows have fewer than 10 isolates (S. pneumoniae 1, beta-haemolytic streptococci 1, Citrobacter 1, S. Typhi 2, S. maltophilia 2, Morganella 2, Providencia 2, Enterobacter 3, P. mirabilis 9).
issues: Second reader 2026-09-26: all 245 cells (the seeded sample of 61 plus every other cell), all 30 row n values and all 22 BSI isolate counts read from the page images (policy pages 3 to 12, BSI pages 2 to 6, scale 2.5) before comparing with the extraction: 0 transcription errors, nothing corrected; organism, specimen and setting correct on every row.

Policy charts: an independent word-position parse of the text layer puts every data label of the 11 organism charts (96 labels, 94 recorded) within 8.1 pt of the axis label of its bar (bars 27 to 50 pt apart), and each label was checked on the image against the bar it sits on. The duplicate MER labels are printed as the extraction describes (Klebsiella bars 1 and 3: 60.1 and 47.6; Enterobacter bars 1 and 3: 52.6 and 68.4, with AZT 47.4 on bar 5 where the abbreviation list has polymyxin B); recorded as extracted. BSI tables: every S% and N/D pair read from the images; each organism n equals the page 2 pie legend.

Cells not kept, each confirmed as printed: 6 conflicts (Klebsiella and Enterobacter meropenem, Enterobacter aztreonam, BSI E. coli co-trimoxazole 32.37 against 61/189, BSI Klebsiella piperacillin-tazobactam 40.07 against 44/108 and polymyxin B 60.01 against 65/108); Enterobacter ceftazidime-avibactam 70.2 (no whole number of 19); polymyxin B cautions E. coli 27.4, Klebsiella 43.7, BSI E. coli 33.33 and BSI Citrobacter 0; intrinsic: Acinetobacter aztreonam 46.4 (printed 46.4%) and 42.64, polymyxin B for Serratia 9.09, Morganella 0, Providencia 0 and P. mirabilis 0.

No count-table mismatch: the blood CoNS counts (S. haemolyticus 213, S. hominis 191, S. xylosus 7) sum to 411 and there is no blood CoNS row. Source quirks confirmed as printed and noted: Serratia n=189 in the second SPICE table with denominators of 11; MRSA plus MSSA 908 of 934 (policy) and 348 of 353 (BSI).
